topography.project_purpose: Autofarm is a yield aggregator that automatically compounds user deposits across multiple DeFi protocols to maximize returns. It operates on numerous blockchains, offering vaults that optimize yield farming strategies.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Autofarm family consists of core vault contracts (AutoFarmV2_CrossChain) deployed across multiple chains, supported by unnamed infrastructure contracts. The AUTOv2 token likely serves as the governance and reward token, integrating with the vaults to incentivize participation.
